caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet shown in side profile, rendered predominantly in a light blue color. The fabric of the bonnet appears smooth with subtle shading, and it features two long blue ties extending down from the front, ending in a bow on the left side. The brim and lower edge of the bonnet are bordered with a wide band of lavender or purple trim that is decorated with a quilted or textured pattern. The bonnet covers the head and drapes down in the back, with a flared skirt-like extension that also has the same decorative trim at its edge. Two small round buttons are illustrated on the side of the fabric, and an inset in the bottom left corner of the drawing contains a simple black line sketch of the same bonnet, showing its outline and ties but without the colored detail. The entire drawing is centered on a plain background, with a rectangular border framing the main image and inset sketch.
title: Opera Hood
